summary.text: AI and semiconductor enthusiasm dominates the batch, with Micron's blowout quarter resetting expectations and traders piling into Microsoft's pullback as a long-term AI capex play through LEAPS and calls.

Geopolitical risk is building as escalating Iran rhetoric and reported Gulf attacks push energy and volatility into focus, while weakening Treasury-equity correlation raises questions about traditional hedging.
Beneath the euphoria, margin calls, underwater META positions, and sarcastic loss confessions reveal pockets of overleverage and pain, tempering the otherwise greed-leaning tone.
